description: A one to eight switch sending its input to whichever output three gates select, read as a binary number

inputs.text: The signal sent to the selected output
The one of the address, adding 1 to the output chosen while it reads above 0V
The two of the address, adding 2 to the output chosen while it reads above 0V
The four of the address, adding 4 to the output chosen while it reads above 0V

outputs.text: Carries the input while the address selects it and 0V the rest of the time, with a light beside it that is lit while it is the one selected

notes: with no address gates patched the address is zero and the input goes to the first of the eight outputs

inputs.0:
bipolar · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
